text:
asha: Heads-up: planning a multi-pool concurrent rack soft-restart for capacity cooldown tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Target pools: gradient-a, gradient-b, edge-saturn. Expected duration ~90m per rack but we stagger.
liam: Is this the one that runs the new NVLINK microcode? any firmware ops included?
asha: No low-level FW flips, just soft reboots + systemd unit restarts. NVLINK patch rolled separate last week.
jordan: Oncall: I can take the first slot. We should canary one rack in gradient-a with traffic mirrored.
maya: Any customer-facing impact? will hosted API hit error rates or increased tail latency?
liam: Minimal for hosted; bursts might hit 99.9th pct latency. We'll route high-priority tenants to reserved pools during window.
cody: I'll add a console banner + health-check tweaks. Recommend KV cache reseed after warmbackfill.
asha: Plan: 02:00 UTC start, stagger 15m between racks, canary rack first 30m, 2nd tier after success. Fallback: abort soft-restart if p50 or error rate > baseline+20%.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created: /calendar create "Multi-pool concurrent cooldown" 2026-03-23T02:00Z 90m
jordan: Quick checklist: pre-drain prefix cache, run `./scripts/prime_kv.sh --rack $RACK` before warmbackfill. Monitor tail latency and egress queues.
liam: What about cross-region egress? apac-edge might get congested if we backfill too fast.
asha: We'll cap backfill rate to 200rps per rack and enable egress shaping. If cross-region egress > 70% baseline, pause.
maya: Can we surface impacted tenant list? product wants to pre-notify top 10 affected customers if any.
cody: I'll generate a short impact matrix and post in #customer-notify if any customer-facing SLO risk.
jordan: To SRE: add a short alert: "rack-soft-restart-regen" for 5m spike in 99th > 2x baseline, notify pager after 3m.
ops-bot: Deploy check-run: `./deploy_check --racks gradient-a -c preflight` -> PASS
asha: Cost note: backfill during maintenance increases preemptible usage; estimate ~$1.2k extra credits for this window.
liam: Ack. we'll tag charges to "maintenance-mar-23" and reconcile in finance.
maya: +1 on customer comms. prefer 6hr heads-up email if impact confirmed.
cody: will do. assigning follow-ups: @jordan oncanary, @liam on egress caps, @cody on comms, @asha ops lead.
jordan: good to go. will post final runbook and the playbook snippet in thread 30m before start.
liam: thumbs up :thumbsup: \nasha: thanks all. will update if schedule shifts.
